passages.text: In that day seven women will take hold of one man and say, “We will eat our own bread and provide our own clothes. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our disgrace!”
passages.sermon:
Seven women will take hold of one man.
This will happen on that day.
The women will say something to the man.
They will say, "We will eat our own bread."
They will say, "We will wear our own clothes."
They will say, "Let your name be called over us."
They will say, "Take away our disgrace."
passages.original: וְהֶחֱזִיקוּ֩ שֶׁ֨בַע נָשִׁ֜ים בְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֗ד בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לַחְמֵ֣נוּ נֹאכֵ֔ל וְשִׂמְלָתֵ֖נוּ נִלְבָּ֑שׁ רַ֗ק יִקָּרֵ֤א שִׁמְךָ֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ אֱסֹ֖ף חֶרְפָּתֵֽנוּ׃ס

passages.text: On that day the Branch of the LORD will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of Israel’s survivors.
passages.sermon:
The Branch of the LORD will appear on that day.
The Branch of the LORD will be beautiful.
The Branch of the LORD will be glorious.
The fruit of the land will grow.
The fruit of the land will be the pride of Israel’s survivors.
The fruit of the land will be the glory of Israel’s survivors.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ צֶ֣מַח יְהוָ֔ה לִצְבִ֖י וּלְכָב֑וֹד וּפְרִ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לְגָא֣וֹן וּלְתִפְאֶ֔רֶת לִפְלֵיטַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Whoever remains in Zion and whoever is left in Jerusalem will be called holy— all in Jerusalem who are recorded among the living— when the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and cleansed the bloodstains from the heart of Jerusalem by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of fire.
passages.sermon:
God will leave some people in Zion.
God will leave some people in Jerusalem.
People who remain in Zion and Jerusalem will be called holy.
These people are those whose names are written among the living in Jerusalem.
The Lord will wash away the filth from the daughters of Zion.
The Lord will remove the bloodstains from the heart of Jerusalem.
The Lord will do this by a spirit of judgment.
The Lord will do this by a spirit of fire.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ הַנִּשְׁאָ֣ר בְּצִיּ֗וֹן וְהַנּוֹתָר֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם קָד֖וֹשׁ יֵאָ֣מֶר ל֑וֹ כָּל־ הַכָּת֥וּב לַחַיִּ֖ים בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ אִ֣ם׀ רָחַ֣ץ אֲדֹנָ֗י אֵ֚ת צֹאַ֣ת בְּנוֹת־ צִיּ֔וֹן וְאֶת־ דְּמֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם יָדִ֣יחַ מִקִּרְבָּ֑הּ בְּר֥וּחַ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּבְר֥וּחַ בָּעֵֽר׃

passages.text: Then the LORD will create over all of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud of smoke by day and a glowing flame of fire by night. For over all the glory there will be a canopy, a shelter to give shade from the heat by day, and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and the rain.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will act on Mount Zion.
Mount Zion is the holy mountain in Jerusalem.
The LORD will create something new over every place on Mount Zion.
He will also create this over every gathering on Mount Zion.
During the day, the LORD will make a cloud of smoke.
At night, the LORD will make a bright flame of fire.
The LORD will cover all the glory with a canopy.
This canopy will be a shelter.
The shelter will give shade from the heat during the day.
The shelter will also be a place of safety.
It will protect from storms.
It will protect from rain.
passages.original: וּבָרָ֣א יְהוָ֡ה עַל֩ כָּל־ מְכ֨וֹן הַר־ צִיּ֜וֹן וְעַל־ מִקְרָאֶ֗הָ עָנָ֤ן׀ יוֹמָם֙ וְעָשָׁ֔ן וְנֹ֛גַהּ אֵ֥שׁ לֶהָבָ֖ה לָ֑יְלָה כִּ֥י עַל־ כָּל־ כָּב֖וֹד חֻפָּֽה׃ וְסֻכָּ֛ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְצֵל־ יוֹמָ֖ם מֵחֹ֑רֶב וּלְמַחְסֶה֙ וּלְמִסְתּ֔וֹר מִזֶּ֖רֶם וּמִמָּטָֽר׃פ
